text: But then it will be too late! We must wait—” “It is impossible,” responded the conductor. “If you wish to go, please get in.” “I will not go,” said Aouda. Fix had heard this conversation. A little while before, when there was no prospect of proceeding on the journey, he had made up his mind to leave Fort Kearney; but now that the train was there, ready to start, and he had only to take his seat in the car, an irresistible influence held him back.
